Carrowkeel House – Where Heritage and Contemporary Elegance Converge
Set amid the tranquil countryside of Ballintubber, County Mayo, Carrowkeel House is a distinguished country residence offering an exceptional blend of architectural heritage and modern refinement. Extending across 0.61 hectares (1.5 acres) of manicured grounds, this impressive estate enjoys a sense of privacy and space while remaining deeply connected to one of Mayo’s most historically significant landscapes.
The property comprises a substantial 5,935 sq ft main house, thoughtfully constructed in 2000, alongside a beautifully restored mid-20th-century cottage. Together, they create a harmonious composition that balances traditional form with contemporary comfort. Externally, the symmetry of the main residence, its soft-toned façade and slate roof, presents a timeless country aesthetic that sits effortlessly within its surroundings.
Internally, the main house is defined by generous proportions and elegant detailing. A welcoming entrance hall sets the tone for the home, leading to a series of refined reception rooms ideal for both formal entertaining and everyday living. The kitchen forms the heart of the home — a well-appointed, light-filled space designed for both practicality and sociability, complemented by high-quality finishes and premium appliances.
Five luxurious bedrooms provide private retreats for family and guests alike. The principal suite is particularly impressive, offering generous storage and a spa-like bathroom complete with a private sauna.
The original cottage adds warmth and character, with period-inspired features, inviting living spaces, and flexible rooms suitable for home offices, guest accommodation, or creative use.
Located just moments from Ballintubber Abbey, an enduring symbol of Ireland’s medieval heritage, Carrowkeel House offers a rare opportunity to acquire a home of substance, history, and understated elegance in one of Mayo’s most cherished settings.
The residence is located approximately 8 miles from Castlebar, 12 miles from Ballinrobe, 14 miles from Westport and just 40 minutes from Knock Airport.
All room dimensions are available within floor plans.
Viewing is highly recommended and strictly by appointment with the Sole Agents - Leonard Wilson Keenan Northwest.
